services.name: Restaurant Staffing
services.shortDescription: Permanent kitchen and service teams for restaurants, cafes and cloud kitchens.
services.description: From head chefs and line cooks to waiters and kitchen helpers, we help food businesses hire permanent staff who understand service rhythm and kitchen discipline. Requirements are discussed by section — kitchen, floor and support — so headcount and budgets are planned realistically.

services.name: Hospitality Staffing
services.shortDescription: Housekeeping, front-of-house and support staff for hotels and guest houses.
services.description: Hotels, resorts and guest houses depend on consistent housekeeping and guest-facing teams. We help hire permanent housekeeping staff, waiters, utility staff and security personnel suited to hospitality environments.

services.name: Office Staffing
services.shortDescription: Office assistants, utility and support staff for corporate workplaces.
services.description: Offices need dependable people who keep the workplace running — office assistants, pantry and utility staff, housekeeping and security. We help businesses fill these permanent roles with clear job scopes.

services.name: Retail Staffing
services.shortDescription: Floor helpers, housekeeping and security staff for stores and showrooms.
services.description: Retail stores and showrooms need permanent staff who are presentable, punctual and comfortable with customers. We assist with general helpers, housekeeping and security staff for retail environments.

services.name: Maintenance and Skilled Workforce
services.shortDescription: Plumbers, carpenters, painters and maintenance staff on permanent rolls.
services.description: For businesses that need in-house maintenance capability, we help hire permanent plumbers, carpenters, painters and general maintenance staff. Skill level, tools familiarity and site requirements are discussed before shortlisting.

services.name: Custom Business Staffing
services.shortDescription: Permanent roles that do not fit a standard category.
services.description: If your requirement spans multiple categories or is specific to your business, share it with us. We document the role, discuss a realistic budget and work out a hiring approach that fits.
